sample.biological_model: YFP lineage-marked control muscle regeneration model (Pax7CE/+; RYFP/YFP).
sample.biological_source: Pax7-lineage cells from tibialis anterior and gastrocnemius muscles of male mice aged 2–4 months; mixed genetic background.
sample.sample_material: FACS-isolated YFP-positive Pax7-lineage cells collected 2.5 days after BaCl₂ injury of tibialis anterior and gastrocnemius muscles. Individual donor identities and the extent of pooling across mice are not reported. Source-reported BaCl₂ injection volume per site: 2–4 μL; this non-scalar expression is not replaced by an exact scalar value.
